## Change / 改动

- What changed and where (chapter, section, exercise ID, or file path)? / 改了什么，位置在哪里（章节、节、题号或文件路径）？

## Validation / 检查

- Which checks did you actually run, and what were the results? / 实际运行了哪些检查，结果如何？
- If you did not run code, say so. / 如果没有运行代码，请注明。

## Checklist / 清单

- [ ] Chinese and English prose stay aligned where both are affected. / 涉及中英文时，两种文字保持对应。
- [ ] Original code and educational content retain the licenses stated in `LICENSE.md`; third-party material has source and license credit. / 原创代码与教学内容沿用 `LICENSE.md` 所列许可；第三方材料注明来源与许可。
